# youtrack_app_global_config (Resource)

YouTrack app global configuration resource. Enables or disables an installed app, sets its global settings (the ones an administrator edits under Administration > Apps) and chooses who may use it. The app itself is not installed by this resource. Destroying the resource only removes it from Terraform: the app keeps its configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "youtrack_app_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# The IDs of the groups come from the youtrack_group data source, not from
# values written by hand.
data "youtrack_group" "admins" {
  name = "youtrack-administrators"
}

data "youtrack_group" "registered_users" {
  name = "Registered Users"
}

# Configure an installed app. app_name is the package name listed by
# GET /api/admin/apps, not the title shown in the UI.
resource "youtrack_app_global_config" "agile" {
  app_name = "elca-bundle-values"
  enabled  = true

  # The keys depend on the app: each one declares its own in settings.json.
  # A user group is written as { id = "..." }. The whole document is written
  # whenever this value changes, so keep every setting here, secrets included.
  settings = jsonencode({
    valueManagers   = [{ id = data.youtrack_group.admins.id }]
    apiToken        = var.youtrack_app_token
    youtrackUrl     = "http://youtrack:8080"
    archiveDirectly = false
  })

  permitted_group_ids = [data.youtrack_group.registered_users.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_name` (String) The name of the installed app, as listed by `GET /api/admin/apps` (for example `@jetbrains/youtrack-workflow-due-date`). This is the package name, not the title shown in the UI.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the app is enabled. Defaults to `true`; an app disabled outside of Terraform is enabled again on the next apply.
- `permitted_group_ids` (Set of String) The entity IDs of the user groups allowed to use the app, for example `6-0` for all registered users. Users allowed one by one are left as they are. Leave it out to leave who may use the app alone.
- `settings` (String, Sensitive) The global settings of the app, as a JSON object. Each app declares its own in its `settings.json`, so the keys depend on the app; build the value with `jsonencode()`. The whole document is written whenever this value changes: a key left out is cleared, a secret included. An entity setting, such as a user group, is written as `{ id = "..." }`. Only the keys written here are compared with YouTrack. Settings the app declares as secrets are never returned by YouTrack, so a secret changed outside of Terraform is not detected, and after an import the first apply writes the value from the configuration. Leave it out to leave the settings of the app alone.

### Read-Only

- `app_id` (String) The entity ID of the app. It changes when the app is uninstalled and installed again.
- `id` (String) The entity ID of the app.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Import the configuration of an app using its name, as listed by GET /api/admin/apps.
# settings and permitted_group_ids are not read: the first apply writes the ones
# from the configuration.
terraform import youtrack_app_global_config.agile elca-bundle-values
```
